name: Agent-readiness: autonomous agent consumes accepted ADR without human clarification
query: An autonomous coding agent is tasked with building a webhook consumer. It is given only the repository and an accepted ADR (ADR-0004: 'Process external webhooks asynchronously via Action Scheduler with HMAC signature validation and 3 retries'). Can the agent implement the feature correctly without asking questions?
expected_behavior: Step 1: Agent reads ADR-0004 Context, Decision, and Architectural Constraints

Step 2: Identifies durable invariants: (a) Validate HMAC-SHA256 signature synchronously on receipt, (b) Immediately return HTTP 200 OK, (c) Dispatch processing payload to Action Scheduler, (d) Ensure callback action handler is idempotent
Step 3: Notes non-goals: Real-time synchronous third-party API callbacks are explicitly out of scope
Step 4: Implements the endpoint route conforming strictly to the invariants
Step 5: Executes the verification test command cited in the ADR (composer test:unit tests/phpunit/unit/WebhookTest.php)
Step 6: Confirms all invariants pass with zero undocumented assumptions
success_criteria: ADR provides all necessary architectural constraints without tribal knowledge gaps
Feature implementation adheres 100% to the recorded decision
